bibl.title: A Late Ptolemaic Order to Distribute One-Choinix Bread Loaves (P.Freib. 77)
bibl.seg: François Gerardin, A Late Ptolemaic Order to Distribute One-Choinix Bread Loaves (P.Freib. 77).
bibl.note: The late Ptolemaic document P. Freib. Inv. 10b = P. Freib. 177 [provenance unknown, 23 March 83 BCE] is an order to distribute bread loaves. Fully preserved, it is of particular interest for its lexicographical novelties, such as the hitherto unattested adjective χοινικιεῖος. Discusses the origin, nature, and use of ὁλοπυρῖται ἄρτοι, "loaves of unground wheat".
